name: Ollama MCP
tagline: Run local LLMs from your AI agent — Llama, Mistral, Qwen, Phi, and more.
shortDescription: The official Ollama MCP server. Lets your agent run any local model through Ollama — Llama 3.3, Mistral, Qwen, Phi-4, Gemma, etc. — without sending data to a cloud API. Perfect for privacy-sensitive workloads.
longDescription:
## What it is

The Ollama MCP server, contributed by the Ollama team. Exposes local LLMs as MCP tools so your agent can use them instead of (or alongside) cloud APIs. Supports all Ollama-compatible models: Llama, Mistral, Qwen, Phi, Gemma, DeepSeek, Codellama, and more.

## Why we recommend it

If you need to keep data local (compliance, IP, cost), Ollama is the easiest way to run capable open-source models on your own hardware. The MCP wrapper is the cleanest way to give your agent access to those local models — no cloud calls, no data leaving your machine, no per-token costs.

## When to use it

- Privacy-sensitive workloads (healthcare, finance, legal)
- Offline development environments
- Cost-sensitive agents that need to handle a lot of text
- Local dev where you don't want to call OpenAI's API
installCommand: curl -fsSL https://ollama.com/install.sh | sh && ollama pull llama3.3 && uvx ollama-mcp
installInstructions:
1. Install Ollama: `curl -fsSL https://ollama.com/install.sh | sh`
2. Pull a model: `ollama pull llama3.3` (or `mistral`, `qwen2.5`, `phi4`, etc.)
3. `uvx ollama-mcp`

**Hardware note:** Larger models need GPU memory. Llama 3.3 70B needs 48GB+ VRAM. Start with 8B models for most laptops.
pricingDetails: Free. Ollama is open source. Model weights are free (Llama, Mistral, Qwen, etc.). You pay only for the GPU hardware.
